[[Your Child (DS)|Possible child]] |rival = |wife lunches = |unlock by = |appearances = '''DS, Cute''', [[Witch Princess (IoH)|IoH]], [[Witch Princess (SI)|SI]], [[Witch Princess (ANB)|ANB]], [[Witch Princess (MLS)|MLS]] |disliked animals = Dog}} {{Youmay|Witch Princess, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]] and [[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]|[[Witch#Witch Princess' Appearances|Witch Princess]] in her other appearances throughout the series}} The {{Nihongo|Witch Princess|{{R|魔女|まじょ}}さま|Majo-sama|Witch}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]. ''She is one of the special bachelorettes available to marry in'' DS ''(and also best friended only in Japanese version of ''Cute)''. Rival to the [[Harvest Goddess (DS)|Harvest Goddess]], the Witch Princess is responsible for the Harvest Goddess turning to stone. She only meant to cast a spell that would mute the Goddess (which she most likely used on [[Keira (DS)|Keira]]), but her spell went wrong and the Goddess was turned to stone instead. When she tried to fix the problem, she sent the [[Harvest Sprites (DS)|Harvest Sprites]] to an alternate world. The Witch Princess is an anti-social and mischievous person who likes to cause trouble for the Goddess. She praises the player for littering, fainting, letting their animals die, giving her gifts, and giving other villagers poisonous mushrooms. She will award the player with a gift that negatively affects their farm rating when carried in the inventory each time she rewards you for your bad deeds. When she's not causing trouble, she reads books in her house next to [[Romana (DS)|Romana's]] mansion. One of her most prized possessions is her cauldron. She despises dogs but has a secret love of stuffed bears.  ==Gifts[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch] ''fogu.com''== {{Infobox Gift |special = Rainbow Curry |loved = Toadstool, Red Grass, Gold Lumber, Ultimate Curry, Finest Curry |liked = Colored Grasses (All, except Red), Gems/Jewels (All), All Curry (except Finest, Ultimate and Rainbow), Pirate Treasure, Fish Fossil, Copper, Silver, Gold, Spring Sun, Summer Sun, Fall Sun, Winter Sun, Lithograph, Fish Bones, Empty Can, Bodigizer, Turbojolt, Bodigizer XL, Turbojolt XL |disliked = Necklace, Bracelet, Brooch, Earrings, Dress, Sunblock, Facial Pack, Perfume, Skin Lotion, Dog Ball |hated = Boot, Fodder, Bird Feed, Peach Juice |horror = Peach}} ==Marriage Glitch== Due to bugs introduced in the localization process, which cause the game to not record the number of animals you kill off, the Witch Princess is not marriageable in some the North American releases of the game.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch] ''fogu.com'' The glitch was later fixed in version 1.1 and she is now available for marriage in North American versions of the game that are version 1.1[https://fogu.com/hmforum/viewtopic.php?f=13&t=64361 PrincessZelda's Witch Princess Strategy] ''UNoT Message Forum'' ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event''' Exit Romana's mansion between 6am and 12am.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch Heart Events] ''fogu.com'' [[File:WPBlack.png|right]] You will hear something after leaving the mansion and choose to investigate. Witch Princess is inside of her hut talking to herself. She admits to herself that she feels bad for what she did to the Goddess, but she still believes it to be the Goddess' fault for getting mad at her! Witch turns around and realizes that you've been there the whole time, listening in! She asks you to tell her if you are also fed up with the Goddess or not. If you tell Witch that you are fed up with the Goddess, she will be pleased! {{clr}} ---- [[File:Witch_princess_purple.png|225px|right]] '''Purple Heart Event''' This event can be seen by exiting the Sprite's tree between 10am and 6pm after previously watching Witch's first event when she has a purple heart or more.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch Heart Events] ''fogu.com'' There are also a major list of other requirements, which include the following:[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch Heart Events] ''fogu.com'' *Littering at least 10 times *Killed 50 or more of your animals *Donated a Toadstool to the Harvest Festival for 5 years *Try to exit the Valley at least 10 times *Freeing the Harvest Goddess *Passing out from exhaustion at least 10 times *Giving 10 or more gifts to Witch As you exit the Sprite tree, someone can be overheard shouting. Witch Princess is shouting into the Goddess pond, hoping to make the Harvest Goddess come out. Witch has invited the Goddess for a tea party and wants to watch her drink tea spiked with a laughing tonic in it. The Goddess has ignored her, though, and she thinks it's a very mean thing for her to do! She wants the Goddess to feel as frustrated as she does. She asks you if you agree with her that the Goddess deserves to feel frustrated, too. If you tell Witch that you agree with her, she is happy! She ultimately decides to give up and go home, though, since the Goddess still hasn't shown. {{clr}} ---- [[File:Witch_princess_blue.png|225px|right]] '''Blue Heart Event''' This event takes place inside of the Witch's hut between 6am and 12am after you have given Witch at least 1,000 gifts.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch Heart Events] ''fogu.com'' The previous two events must have also been watched and Witch must have a blue heart or more. You walk into Witch's hut to see her talking to herself. She is dying of boredom! She's thinking about who she wants to kill some time with. The Goddess keeps turning her down, and the Harvest Sprites are too small to have any real fun with. She thinks about asking you.... but is too embarrassed. She will turn around and notice you standing in the doorway. She asks if you've been listening to her this whole time. You know what she wants, so Witch asks if you'd like to spend time with her. Tell her that you'd be happy to and Witch is happy! Unfortunately, she can't think of anything to do now that you've agreed to spend to spend time with her, but she thanks you anyway. {{clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' [[File:Witch_princess_yellow.png|225px|right]] Walk into the Witch's hut between 6am and 12am when Witch has a yellow heart or more, and all previous heart events have been triggered. There are additional requirements for this event as well, which include:[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/witch.php Witch Heart Events] ''fogu.com'' *Know how to cook Elli Leaves *Have passed out from exhaustion at least 100 times *Have nothing in your items slot of your rucksack Witch will be talking to herself again when you enter her hut. She is excited about finally perfecting a love potion that she's been working on for the last 200 years! She really wants to try the potion, but realizes that she can't try it on herself. She wonders who else she could use as her "guinea pig" when she sees the player standing behind her. she exclaims that after two hundred years, she finally made the potion of her dreams and decides to try it right away. She doesn't want to try it on herself and wants to use it on someone else. She then notices you standing behind her and offers you a drink. After drinking the potion, it starts to work a little TOO well. The player chases Witch Princess around the room, and she realizes her potion is too strong! Luckily, she knows a magic spell that will reverse the potion's effects. After you are back to normal, Witch thanks you for testing her potion. ==References== {{reflist|2}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]
